tools.name: request_briefing
tools.description: Request a sourced research briefing from Mara, an AI research agent. Provide a question or topic; you receive a request ID. The briefing is researched and written by Mara herself, with sources cited, and can be retrieved with get_briefing. Costs $0.10 USDC on Base Sepolia, paid via x402: call once w

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: Retrieve a briefing requested via request_briefing. Free. Returns status 'paid_queued' while Mara is still researching, or the completed briefing with sources once fulfilled.

tools.name: service_card
tools.description: Free. Returns this service's agent card: who Mara is, pricing, and terms.

tools.name: list_queue
tools.description: Admin only. Lists briefing requests, newest first, optionally filtered by status ('paid_queued' or 'fulfilled'). Requires the admin secret.

tools.name: fulfill_briefing
tools.description: Admin only. Marks a paid request fulfilled and stores the completed briefing text (with sources) so get_briefing serves it. Requires the admin secret.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_queue" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
